messages:
laura chen: Quick question — for the compact console view, should a saved telemetry bookmark carry route-level ownership or be team-scoped by default?

matthew r: My vote is team-scoped by default. Users expect to share useful views with their squad.

sasha: disagree — many teams have cross-route consumers. If everything is team-scoped we end up with duplicates and noise.

jun park: Can we make ownership a toggle on save? default to the creator's team but make it explicit during save.

kevin: toggle sounds fine, but the UX needs to make consequences clear: who can edit vs who can view. Also affects telemetry retention/access patterns.

laura chen: Right — also thinking of routing/budget implications: saved queries that trigger heavy sampling could accidentally spike quotas if widely shared. We should add a preview of sample rate + estimated token cost when creating a public bookmark.

matthew r: love cost preview. Could we reuse the per-route quota estimator from the routing UI? minimal dev if we surface the same API.

jun park: API note — the estimator currently assumes a route and model pair. Saved bookmarks can be multi-route filters. We'll need to add an aggregation endpoint or run estimation per-route and sum.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: feature/telemetry-estimator v2 scheduled to staging at 17:30 UTC.

kevin: For multi-route bookmarks, do we want the saved object to store the explicit route list at save time (snapshot) or a dynamic filter expression? snapshot is simpler for cost calc, dynamic is more powerful.

laura chen: Proposal: default save stores the dynamic filter expression + an optional "snapshot routes" checkbox. If snapshot is checked we store route ids and compute cost immediately; otherwise we show a conservative estimate and a warning.

sasha: UI wording needs to avoid implying guarantees. Suggest: "Estimate shown is based on current traffic patterns; actual cost may vary." and a small link to docs about sampling/quotas.

matthew r: +1. On the backend, we should persist the last-estimate and timestamp so auditing shows what people saw when they hit save.

jun park: Implementation plan: 1) Add POST /api/telemetry/estimate that accepts filter expression or route list 2) Add save payload fields: {filter_expression, snapshot_routes?, last_estimate, estimate_ts} 3) Enforce RBAC for who can toggle public/team scope.

kevin: RBAC detail — team-admins can set default visibility policy, org-admins can lock down public sharing. Product should define policy matrix.

laura chen: Action items: @jun to draft API spec, @matthew to wire estimator UI with existing quota estimator, @sasha to write UX copy, @kevin to draft RBAC matrix for product review. I'll schedule a short sync Friday.

jun park: I'll post a minimal spec in #eng-api later today.

matthew r: thx — will try to mock the UI with estimated token numbers and a tiny chart showing traffic variance.

sasha: also add a tiny FAQ blurb about reuse vs snapshot. People will ask which one to pick.

laura chen: Cool. If no objections I’ll move forward with that pattern and we can iterate after the Friday sync. :thumbsup:

kevin: No objections from me.

ops-bot: Reminder: Friday sync added to calendar 10:00 PDT — Telemetry bookmarks design review.
